messages:
maya: Quick sync — after yesterday's exec ask we need to decide what actually ships in the 'lean launch' (MVP) vs what we defer to v1. timeline probably shifts by ~2 weeks if we keep the full telemetry surface.
liam: Can you list the candidate items for deferment? i can call out engineering cost.
anita: From PM side: telemetry retention, multi-tenant audit logs, tenant-level RBAC, advanced retry policies, and custom webhook schema are the big ones.
rohan: Also the initial ML reranking pipeline for search — high dev time and not required for core flow.
maya: My proposal: MVP = core inference endpoints, basic metrics (requests, latencies), simple per-tenant usage. v1 = long-retention telemetry, RBAC, deep rerank. That would save ~3 sprint-weeks.
liam: Rough estimate: removing rerank and RBAC saves ~2.5 engineer-sprints. telemetry retention (>=90 days) is mainly infra work, 1.5 sprints.
anita: Customers that flagged this (Acme, Belltown) said they need compliance today but can accept a migration plan if we promise v1 within 8 weeks.
maya: Two constraints: 1) sales needs a firm commit window for Acme (for their pilot). 2) SRE needs the ability to roll back faster if latency spikes during canary.
rohan: For rollback, we can add a simpler fallback to smaller model family (quantized variant) that ships with MVP. little infra work. liam: yeah that + a feature-flagged canary should cover SRE concerns.
anita: Acceptance criteria for MVP (draft):
- API: inference, chat/state, embeddings all stable under 99th pct latency SLOs
- Observability: request-level traces, 30-day metrics retention, alerting on token-cost regression
- Security: per-tenant isolation and basic API key controls
- Known omissions: RBAC, long retention, multi-tenant audit logs, advanced webhooks
maya: If we agree, we push those omissions to v1 and shift the internal launch date by 10 business days to allow the retention infra spike.
liam: Can we do a parallel effort for retention infra as a low-priority backlog item? maybe one engineer 20% for 2 sprints. that avoids full shift.
anita: Sales would like the commitment date — can we promise v1 within 8 weeks from MVP if we add that parallel track?
rohan: Depends on QA capacity. QA has a freeze during the next sprint for migrations. that adds risk.
maya: Ok decision options: A) Keep launch date, add 20% eng for retention, accept higher risk on QA. B) Move launch by 10 business days and keep full QA. C) Ship with retention short window and offer migration plan to customers.
liam: My vote B — less firefighting post-launch.
anita: Sales will push for A. but I'll align expectations if we pick B.
rohan: B for me too. gives SRE breathing room.
maya: All right. decision = B. Action items:
- anita: update Acme pilot commit (message to account exec) by EOD
- liam: sketch the minimal retention plan and staffing needs by tomorrow noon
- rohan: implement fallback-to-quantized-model PR and feature flag (target end of week)
- maya: update milestone in tracker + canary window plan
- deploy-bot: remind #product tomorrow 0900 for status updates (reaction :bell:)
liam: noted. I'll drop a short spec into the milestone doc with ETA.
anita: I'll draft the customer communication, call out v1 timeline.
maya: Thanks everyone. We'll re-check on the 09:00 sync. :thumbsup:
